body:
Alon's random-projective-plane transversal conjecture remains unresolved in this attempt. This package records the classical lower bound q + sqrt(q) + 1, the standard (1 + o(1)) q log q alteration upper bound, and an exact weighted minimal-blocker reduction. The needed growing lower multiplier is not proved, and no new discovery is claimed.

The source audit preserves the shared-random-point model, identifies duplicate target 30006391, and explains why the independent-incidence theorem and the cited direct container statements do not supply the missing lower bound. Two of five substantive attempts were used before both selected routes stalled.

A separate adversarial AI review passed the stated partial results after correcting one cited inequality sign. The submitted diagnostics reproduced exactly; a separate affine-coordinate checker passed 28,072 assertions over all 8,320 point subsets in PG(2,2) and PG(2,3). These finite checks do not establish the asymptotic conjecture.

All changes are confined to `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30006390/`. The shared queue disposition is unsolved and is handled separately. This is an unrefereed research checkpoint, not a full solution or a priority claim.
title: Record unresolved random-transversal baseline and independent review
